item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu text in the selected lyric and moved the Roman transcription to `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have a two-line opening and four matching two-line stanzas. Set the direction to `rtl` and removed `noUrdu`.

I rendered “Kaza” as قضا and retained the ambiguous closing “Zehar” as زہر.
